entries.name: Fighter
entries.summary: A martial class built around weapon skill, armor, and repeated attacks.
entries.beginnerTip: Start with the weapon shown on your sheet; the app tracks when class features add more choices.

source.adaptation: Original short-form beginner summary; verify mechanics against the cited SRD.

entries.name: Human
entries.summary: A broadly adaptable race option for many classes and concepts.
entries.beginnerTip: This is a flexible choice; class and background will define much of your play style.

source.adaptation: Original short-form beginner summary; no source prose reproduced.

entries.name: Attack
entries.summary: Make one or more attacks as allowed by your current features.
entries.beginnerTip: Choose a listed weapon. The app rolls the attack first and waits for the DM's hit decision before damage.

entries.name: Dash
entries.summary: Spend your action to gain additional movement for the current turn.
entries.beginnerTip: Choose this when your normal movement is not enough to reach the place you want.

source.adaptation: Original beginner summary; exact calculation remains engine data.

entries.name: Saving Throw
entries.summary: A defensive roll made when an effect tests one of your abilities.
entries.beginnerTip: The DM tells you which ability to use; tap that save on your sheet and report the total.

entries.name: Restrained
entries.summary: A condition that sharply limits movement and affects attacks and defenses.
entries.beginnerTip: Apply the condition, then open Why? on any changed value to see the active modifiers.

source.adaptation: Original beginner summary; exact modifiers remain engine data.
